title: sparganium emersum var. acaule
intro: Sparganium emersum var. acaule, commonly known as American bur-reed or water spangle, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Typhaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Sparganium emersum var. acaule include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
